findings.highlight: I won’t lose my legs just from money talk
findings.evidenceJa: 金の話で腰なんか抜けるか
findings.governingReading: Shirou insists that merely hearing a price cannot make him collapse in shock.
findings.explanation: Lose my legs literalizes the idiom into physical limb loss or failure.

findings.governingReading: Shirou wilts under an astronomical figure in a compressed comic phrase joining physical collapse to scale.
findings.explanation: It’s astronomical preserves only magnitude and removes the limp, buckling reaction.

findings.highlight: if you convert it into damages
findings.evidenceJa: ダメージに換算したら
findings.governingReading: If converted into damage, the number would defeat any boss in one hit.
findings.explanation: Damages conventionally means monetary compensation; the plural is wrong for game damage.

findings.highlight: as much courage as I can
findings.governingReading: Shirou voices the strongest bravado he can muster when asking Rin to let him owe the money.
findings.explanation: Courage treats the performance as sincere bravery and loses his strained bluff.
